verdict.rationale: Carta's own docs confirm that SAFEs and convertible notes live on the cap table. They can be queried through the cap-table MCP plugin, and convertible notes can be retrieved through the API, which covers the 'land on the cap table' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows founders creating, sending, or e-signing these instruments in-platform, or modeling their conversion terms. Missing for 10: in-platform SAFE/note creation, sending to investors, e-signature, conversion-terms modeling (caps, discounts, pro-forma conversion), independent or hands-on corroboration.
